c74object.name: evi.tremolo~
c74object.digest: Basic Tremolo effect with saturation and choice of LFO shapes
c74object.description:
evi.tremolo~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tremolo.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tremolo~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
An example of a tremolo using evieve primitives. Variable control of LFOs for interesting modulation. The tremolo amplitude can be driven well above unity gain into an antialiased saturation stage.

inlet.description: Reset of internal LFO phases is naive and not antialiased.

outlet.description: The currently computed speed in Hz of the modulating LFOs. This is important for downstream processing because if @lfomode is on, this will not necessarily be synchronised with changes to the @rate attribute.
Left LFO output for downstream synchronisation.
Right LFO output for downstream synchronisation.

attribute.name: crossover
attribute.description: Crossover frequency in Hz. Below this crossover point (the bass) the audio is mono summed, saturated and added back into the wet output mix. Above this crossover point the audio is chanelled through the tremolo effect.

attribute.name: depth
attribute.description: Internally, increasing depth increases the amplitude size of the LFO movement.

attribute.name: drive
attribute.description: 0..1 equates to about 0..+10 dB drive gain into the saturation stage. evi.tremolo~ can be safely overdriven to modulation well above unity gain and remain antialiased on output.

attribute.name: lfoinvert
attribute.description: Invert the wave shape of the current LFO shape. Switching is synchronised to the zero phase of the LFOs.

attribute.name: lfomode
attribute.description: If on, changes to the speed (@rate) of the internal LFOs are synchronised to zero reset of phase, which can produce seemless updating of speed changes. Otherwise the speed (@rate) updates smoothly morphing changes.

attribute.name: lfoout
attribute.description: Switch the LFO outputs (outlets 3 and 4) to output raw 0..1 range or output the actual amplitude used by the effect.

attribute.name: lfowave
attribute.description: The shape of the LFOs driving the modulation. 0=bypass, 1=up, 2=down, 3=tri, 4=sine (default), 5=tanh, 6=square, 7=rand step, 8=rand linear, 9=rand cubic, 10=noise. Switching LFO wave is synchronised to zero crossing phase. LFOs are always slightly smoothed, even hard edges such as square and random.

attribute.name: lfowidth
attribute.description: The pulse width of the LFO wave shapes that use it: 3=triangle, 5=tanh, 6=square.

attribute.name: maxhz
attribute.description: The maximum in Hz that the @rate attribute can reach.

attribute.name: rate
attribute.description: The global speed of the LFO phases. This sets the speed (between 0..@maxhz) the LFOs scale the amplitudes (set by @depth and @drive).

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: The smoothing time of the internal parameters.

attribute.name: spread
attribute.description: The left/right spread of the audio outputs, actually the phase offset of the two internal LFOs. 0..1 is mapped to 0..180 degrees shift.
